newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR STARTS NEW WEEK FIRMER ON UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR STARTS NEW WEEK FIRMER ON UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted firmer on most key units in early Monday interbank trade, dealers said.
They expected the market to remain quiet the whole day, with a fair balance between importer demand for foreign currency and export supply.
"The (central) Reserve Bank's policy in the market is what will probably give it direction today," one dealer said.
At around 0730 GMT the local unit was trading at 11.3800.3900 against the U.S. dollar compared to 11.3825/3925 at Friday's close and was at 19.2320/2620 from 19.3000/3280 versus sterling.
Against the mark it was also firmer at 6.4030/4050 in comparison with 6.4555/4565 but eased marginally versus South Africa's rand to 2.5025/5030 from 2.5000/5010.
